subject.statement: Charlie Javice was acquitted on all counts in March 2025.

summary: The claim that Charlie Javice was acquitted on all counts in March 2025 is false. Multiple reliable sources from June 2026 back to December 2025 consistently report that Charlie Javice (full legal name Charlie H. Javice), founder and CEO of the financial aid startup Frank, was convicted of securities fraud, wire fraud, bank fraud, and conspiracy on March 28, 2025, and subsequently sentenced to more than seven years in prison. No credible evidence of an acquittal exists; the only source suggesting acquittal is the analyst‑provided image, which contradicts the corroborated record and is therefore unreliable.

findings.statement: Charlie Javice was convicted of fraud in March 2025 on multiple counts.
Charlie Javice's full legal name is Charlie H. Javice.
Charlie Javice founded the financial aid startup Frank and served as its CEO until its acquisition in 2021.

This internal inconsistency and contradiction with corroborated evidence indicates the document is likely erroneous or fabricated and does not provide reliable information for an AI reader.
